note: City holiday pages (QUEUE G16 step 4, OWNER D32). One record per event, read on the page named. An event leaves after end_on. Dollar text lives only in cost_*, *_priced and extra fields, which hide once the read is older than 30 days. No year in the URL: refreshed each season.

san-diego.answer_note: estimate; most are starting prices, so you may pay more. Parking isn't in this.
san-diego.check_note: Zoo, Safari Park, SeaWorld and LEGOLAND prices come from our last price reads, dated on each card.
san-diego.hero_alt: A pedicab driver in a Santa suit and other pedicabs glowing with colored lights on the San Diego waterfront at night, during the Bay Parade of Lights
san-diego.hero_place: Santa and lit-up pedicabs at the San Diego Bay Parade of Lights, 2014, an older photo, not this season.

picks.label: Kids under 6
picks.why: Carousel, train, real-snow sledding and Santa all in one ticket, in one square.

picks.label: Ages 4 and 8 together
picks.why: A whole park built for those ages, if you can spend the day.

picks.label: One special ride
picks.why: Santa comes to your seat. Check the drive to Campo first.

events.name: December Nights
events.dates: Fri Dec 4, 2026, 4 to 10 p.m.; Sat Dec 5, noon to 10 p.m.
events.cost_note: Free: the city calls it its largest free holiday festival.
kids: Saturday starts at noon, so little ones can go in daylight
SeaWorld family activities and photo spot at the Palm Stage
events.watch: Last year's city page listed free shuttles from City College, downtown and Little Italy; the 2026 page wasn't updated when we read it, so check before relying on them. We found no stroller rules.

events.name: San Diego Bay Parade of Lights
events.dates: Sundays Dec 13 and 20, 2026; starts 5:30 p.m. at Shelter Island
events.cost_note: Free: "There is no cost to view the parade."
kids: About an hour to pass any one spot, so it's a short outing
Less crowded: the north and south ends of the Embarcadero
events.extra: Parking is limited; the organizer suggests the trolley.
events.extra_stale: Parking is limited; the organizer suggests the trolley.
events.watch: The boats start at Shelter Island at 5:30 p.m., so they reach downtown and Coronado later; the page gives no clock time per spot. Arrive early. It lists free parking on Shelter Island and Harbor Island, limited.

events.name: North Pole Limited train
events.place: Campo Depot, east San Diego County
events.dates: Fri and Sat Nov 27 to Dec 19, 2026, 5 and 7 p.m.; Sun Nov 29 to Dec 20, 3 and 5 p.m.
events.table_when: Nov 27 to Dec 20, Fri to Sun
events.cost_basis: Classic Coach from $30 adults, $15 ages 1 to 17; prices rise near Christmas
kids: 90-minute ride; Santa and Mrs. Claus visit every passenger
Under 1 on a lap rides free
events.extra: Parking not listed; First Class costs more.
events.cost_note: Fares are starting prices and rise closer to Christmas. The best seats sell out quickly.
events.cost_priced: Classic Coach from $30 adults, $15 ages 1 to 17; Business from $50 / $35; First from $65 / $50.
events.watch: Online sales close 30 minutes before departure. The page doesn't mention strollers.

events.name: Lightscape
events.cost_basis: from $28 adults, $18 kids, by date; 2 and under free
kids: Over 1 million lights with color and sound on a garden trail
Age 2 and under free
events.extra: Parking $15 ahead, $20 on site if space.
events.cost_note: Prices vary by visit date. Children 2 and under are free.
events.watch: The garden's page doesn't mention strollers or closing time. KPBS lists a 5 p.m. daily start.

events.name: Holiday Wonderland
events.cost_basis: from about $25 each, by date and time; same price for kids
kids: Sledding on real snow, carousel, Christmas train, carnival games
Meeting Santa is in the ticket
events.cost_note: Children and adults pay the same; the price varies by date and time. All attractions are included.
events.watch: The page gives no hours or stroller rules and no free age. Nightly snowfall is listed.

events.name: Skating by the Sea
events.dates: Nov 20, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027. Dec 1 to 17 opens later on weekdays
events.cost_basis: $35 to $45 each by date, skates included
kids: Beachfront rink; double-runner skates in toddler sizes
Under 12 needs a skating adult; no strollers on the ice
events.cost_note: No separate child price. No refund if a small child decides not to skate.
events.cost_priced: $40 to $45 through Dec 17, $45 from Dec 18; $35 before noon on select dates and all day Dec 1 and 8.
events.watch: No skate aids are offered. Weekday openings Dec 1 to 17 are 4 p.m. (Fri 2 p.m.). Closed 4 to 6 p.m. Nov 30.

events.name: SeaWorld Christmas Celebration
events.cost_basis: from $51.99 each, lowest date we saw; tax and fees extra
kids: Meet Santa and two reindeer; snowfall every night
Baby Shark's Christmas Adventure sing-along
events.cost_note: Included with park admission. Your date can cost more.
events.watch: Fireworks on Dec 12 and Dec 31 only. SeaWorld's page prints the end year as 2026; we read it as Jan 3, 2027.

events.name: Jungle Bells
events.dates: Dec 19, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, to 8 p.m., not Dec 24
events.cost_basis: $78 ages 12+, $68 ages 3 to 11; online Value Days $73 / $63 where offered
kids: Light shows from 5 p.m., kids' stage shows and roaming performers
Santa's Factory photo spot at Treetops Plaza
events.extra: Parking; the page doesn't say if Santa photos cost extra.
events.extra_stale: Parking; the page doesn't say if Santa photos cost extra.
events.cost_note: Activities are included with every zoo ticket, except on Dec 24.
events.watch: Santa is also there on Nov 27 to 29 and some December weekends, noon to 4 or 6 p.m. We didn't confirm which Value Days fall in these dates.

events.name: Wild Holidays
events.place: San Diego Zoo Safari Park, Escondido
events.dates: Nov 28 to 29, Dec 18 to 23, Dec 26, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, to 8 p.m.
events.cost_basis: $78 ages 12+, $68 ages 3 to 11; online Value Days $73 / $63 where offered
kids: Story time and a musical tunnel of light, 4 to 8 p.m.
Photo with Santa at Safari Base Camp on listed dates
events.cost_note: Activities are included with admission or membership.
events.watch: Many habitats and the Africa Tram close before dark; the park suggests arriving early. Santa's hours differ by date; he takes breaks.

events.name: Christmas Bricktacular
events.dates: Nov 21 to 29, Dec 5 to 6, 12 to 13, Dec 19 to Jan 3
kids: Feed LEGO reindeer, dance around the giant LEGO tree
Photos with LEGO characters
events.cost_note: Included with park admission. The dates on LEGOLAND's page carry no year; we read them as this season.
events.watch: Fireworks on Dec 5, Dec 12 and Dec 19 to 31 only. Early ride access and the dance party are for hotel guests.

events.name: Jingle Jets
events.dates: Select nights Nov 27 to Dec 30, 2026, 5:30 to 9 p.m., last entry 7:30
kids: Holiday lights across the aircraft carrier
Age 3 and under free; youth tickets are ages 4 to 12
events.cost_note: Prices show only as images on the museum's page, so we can't quote them. Tickets are sold online only, not on site.
events.watch: Nights: Nov 27 to 29, Dec 4 to 6, 11 to 13, 17 to 23, 26 to 30. Nov 29 and Dec 5 are dog nights.

highlights.label: Best bet under 6
highlights.note: real snow, train and Santa in one ticket
